title: 백엔드 처리 흐름 (실시간)
description: 불량제로 검사 서비스 현황 — 현장 작업자·관리자용

panels.title: 검사 처리 흐름 (최근 15분)
panels.description: 검사 요청이 화면 → 검사 서버 → 판정·분류 → 저장까지 어떻게 지나가는지 보여 줍니다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT r.prediction, d.latency_ms AS d_ms, c.request_id AS c_id, c.latency_ms AS c_ms,
         c.confidence, c.defect_type
  FROM inference_requests r
  JOIN detector_results d ON d.request_id = r.id
  LEFT JOIN classifier_results c ON c.request_id = r.id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(r.created_at)
), base AS (
  SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE prediction = 'defect') / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS defect_pct
  FROM inference_requests
  WHERE created_at <  $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND created_at >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '7 days'
), w AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total,
         100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE prediction = 'defect') / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS defect_pct,
         100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE prediction = 'normal') / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS normal_pct,
         avg(d_ms) AS detector_ms,
         avg(c_ms) AS classifier_ms,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE prediction = 'defect'
                          AND (c_id IS NULL OR defect_type IS NULL OR confidence < ${low_conf})) AS review_cnt
  FROM cur
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(round(w.defect_pct, 1), 0)    AS defect_pct,
  COALESCE(round(w.normal_pct, 1), 0)    AS normal_pct,
  COALESCE(round(w.detector_ms), 0)      AS detector_ms,
  COALESCE(round(w.classifier_ms), 0)    AS classifier_ms,
  w.review_cnt                           AS review_cnt,
  round(w.total / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) / 60, 1), 2)
                                         AS rows_per_min,
  COALESCE(round(abs(w.defect_pct - b.defect_pct), 1), 0) AS defect_dev
FROM w CROSS JOIN base b

SELECT
  COALESCE('모델 v' || det.v, '기록 없음') AS detector_label,
  COALESCE('모델 v' || cls.v, '기록 없음') AS classifier_label,
  COALESCE('판정 v' || det.v, '판정 -') || ' · ' || COALESCE('분류 v' || cls.v, '분류 -') AS mlflow_label
FROM
  (SELECT d.model_version AS v FROM detector_results d
     JOIN inference_requests r ON r.id = d.request_id
    ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) det
  FULL JOIN
  (SELECT c.model_version AS v FROM classifier_results c
     JOIN inference_requests r ON r.id = c.request_id
    ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) cls ON true

SELECT
  COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(created_at) FILTER (WHERE prediction = 'defect')), 999999) AS since_defect,
  COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - max(created_at) FILTER (WHERE prediction = 'normal')), 999999) AS since_normal
FROM inference_requests
WHERE created_at > now() - interval '1 day'

0.text: ■ 검사 서버 중단 · 관리자 확인 필요

text.fixed: 화살표: 진한 색 = 1분 안에 검사 지나감 · 흐린 색 = 10분 안 · 회색 = 10분 넘게 없음 (불량 경로 주황, 정상 경로 초록)   |   테두리: 초록 정상 · 주황 주의 · 빨강 장애

targets.rawSql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT r.prediction, c.request_id AS cid, c.defect_type, c.confidence
  FROM inference_requests r
  LEFT JOIN classifier_results c ON c.request_id = r.id
  WHERE r.created_at >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')
), b AS (
  SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE prediction = 'defect') / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS p
  FROM inference_requests
  WHERE created_at >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') - interval '7 days' AND created_at < (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')
)
SELECT
  count(*)                                               AS today_total,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE prediction = 'defect')          AS today_defects,
  COALESCE(round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE prediction = 'defect') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1), 0)
                                                         AS today_defect_pct,
  round((SELECT p FROM b), 1)                            AS week_defect_pct,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE prediction = 'defect'
                   AND (cid IS NULL OR defect_type IS NULL OR confidence < ${low_conf}))
                                                         AS today_review
FROM t

panels.title: 시간대별 검사·불량 (최근 24시간)
panels.description: 1시간 단위 검사 수와 불량 판정 수입니다. 불량이 갑자기 늘거나 검사가 끊긴 시간을 찾을 때 봅니다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(r.created_at, '1h'),
  count(*)                                       AS "검사 수",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.prediction = 'defect') AS "불량 판정"
FROM inference_requests r
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 오늘 결함 종류
panels.description: 오늘 불량 판정된 이미지의 결함 종류별 건수입니다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE c.defect_type WHEN 'brown' THEN '갈적색' WHEN 'black' THEN '흑색' WHEN 'blue' THEN '청색' WHEN 'surface' THEN '표면' ELSE '분류 안 됨' END AS "결함 종류", count(*) AS "건수"
FROM inference_requests r
JOIN classifier_results c ON c.request_id = r.id
WHERE r.prediction = 'defect' AND r.created_at >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: 최근 불량 판정 30건
panels.description: 가장 최근 불량 판정입니다. '재검토 필요'는 결함 종류를 못 찾았거나 확신도가 낮아 사람이 다시 확인해야 하는 건입니다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  r.created_at                                         AS "검사 시각",
  r.filename                                           AS "이미지",
  CASE c.defect_type WHEN 'brown' THEN '갈적색' WHEN 'black' THEN '흑색' WHEN 'blue' THEN '청색' WHEN 'surface' THEN '표면' ELSE '분류 안 됨' END                                          AS "결함 종류",
  round((c.confidence * 100)::numeric, 1)              AS "확신도",
  CASE WHEN c.request_id IS NULL OR c.defect_type IS NULL OR c.confidence < ${low_conf}
       THEN '재검토 필요' ELSE '확인됨' END                 AS "상태",
  'v' || d.model_version                               AS "판정 모델"
FROM inference_requests r
JOIN detector_results d ON d.request_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN classifier_results c ON c.request_id = r.id
WHERE r.prediction = 'defect'
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
LIMIT 30
